queries: WITH per AS (SELECT cs.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(*) AS records FROM constructorStandings cs LEFT JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId GROUP BY cs.constructorId, c.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, records, records - (SELECT AVG(records) FROM per) AS diff_from_avg FROM per ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS records FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, records, records - (SELECT AVG(records) FROM per) AS diff_from_avg FROM per ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT cs.constructorId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorStandings cs GROUP BY cs.constructorId) SELECT c.constructorId, k.nationality, c.cnt AS standings_records, c.cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg FROM c LEFT JOIN constructors k ON k.constructorId = c.constructorId ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is the mean number of standings records per constructor, taken over constructors that have at least one standings record. Constructors with zero records are not counted.

alternatives.interpretation: The average is taken over all constructors in the constructors table, including those with zero standings records.
alternatives.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS records FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, records, records - (SELECT AVG(records) FROM per) AS diff_from_avg FROM per ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average per constructor is taken over constructors that have at least one standings record (constructors with none are excluded from the average).
Each row in constructorStandings counts as one standings record (one per constructor per race).

alternatives.interpretation: Average computed over all constructors in the constructors table, including those with zero standings records.
